content.subject: Funding round and reconciliation workload
content.draft_text:
Hi Alex,
ShipBob raised $200M, valuing the company over $1B. Such financing often expands reconciliation workload across teams, creating significant hidden manual effort and data mismatches today.
We automate manual reconciliation workflows for operations teams, linking transaction sources to a single truth ledger.
Worth a 15-minute call next week?
Zamp
